gates.title: Project Type Classification
gates.note: Existing project: .NET 10 / C# 14 console CLI (MCP + Agent Skill scanner). RESTRICTED posture, ENHANCED governance, SENIOR team.

gates.title: Repository Standards
gates.note: Walked 2026-10-10. TRUE: repo under SignalCoding, default main, origin/main tracked, visibility PUBLIC by design (Apache-2.0 tool), Dependabot alerts ON (204), CODEOWNERS + PR/issue templates present, release-please proven end-to-end (3.0.3/3.0.4/3.1.0), PR-title Conventional Commits check, CI green. NOT YET TRUE, all owner-settable: (1) NO branch protection on main - gh api .../branches/main/protection returns 404 and the only ruleset ('Code Quality Copilot review') is enforcement=disabled; (2) secret scanning, push protection and Dependabot security updates all disabled; (3) the delivered gitleaks workflow cannot run - gitleaks-action@v2 needs a paid GITLEAKS_LICENSE secret for org-owned repos and has failed on main since bootstrap, so item 1.3 is unevidenceable (decision 4); (4) three actions unpinned (actions/checkout@v4, amannn/action-semantic-pull-request@v5, gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v2) in gitleaks.yml and pr-title.yml, while ci.yml is SHA-pinned. EXEMPT rather than PASS so the gap is printed at every gate run; owner: Signal Coding.

gates.note: Applicable, not NA: governance level is ENHANCED, and spec/test/implementation/security/delegation artefacts are kept per change under _docs/ai/.

gates.note: Captured 2026-10-10 on the adoption branch: dotnet 10.0.401 and the CLI enumerating its rule registry, this product's equivalent of serving one real request (CONSTITUTION #21).

gates.title: Riskiest-Integration Spike
gates.note: NOT NA - this product's riskiest integrations are live: an MCP client over four transports against hostile third-party servers, plus OSV dependency lookups. Spiked and measured against live public servers and a labelled adversarial corpus (72% detection, 27% of benign controls firing).

gates.title: Architecture Foundation
gates.note: Artefact present per the adoption decision, but still the GENERIC template starter - it has not been rewritten with this project's actual layering (Core/Scanner/Tests, rule engine, MCP transports). Follow-up, not a blocker: the architecture is in fact stable and shipped.

gates.title: Security Deployment Assurance
gates.note: Most recent security-reviewer pass (STRIDE + OWASP) on a shipped change. Disclosure policy is published in SECURITY.md; egress is gated by OfflineGuard and Config/RemoteUrlPolicy.cs.

gates.title: MCP Integration
gates.note: NOT NA - the product IS an MCP client (Streamable HTTP, stdio, WebSocket, legacy HTTP+SSE) and parses MCP capability negotiation. Evidenced by the live server matrix in the artefact; the example file's 'no MCP surface in the product' was the template's placeholder and was false here.

gates.title: Communication Cadence
gates.note: Proactive updates; pause for technology, architecture, security-approach and scope decisions.

gates.title: Invariant Fingerprints
